name: Evangel Clement
source:
Cold, confident, hardworking. To many others, Evan seems to be this immovable force, unyielding towards anyone or anything. He's also known to be mysterious and extremely private. Aside from Enjel—his younger brother, nobody else knows what he's thinking, what he's feeling, or even his background.

[From [url=https://syllphana.itch.io/rotten-angel]itch.io[/url]]
